projects.name: AgentPCAP
projects.problem: Agent failures cross model, tool, MCP, and A2A boundaries that ordinary application logs do not join.
projects.proof: Open .apcap schema, canonical protocol and failure-mode vectors, plus documented CI quality gates.

projects.name: mcpwall
projects.problem: Tool-capable models need a small, inspectable security boundary before requests reach local MCP servers.
projects.proof: Versioned v1.0.5 release, public firewall tests, release checksums, and a dedicated security workflow.

projects.name: ModelForge
projects.problem: Model deployment choices are usually made through trial, OOM failures, and untraceable sizing assumptions.
projects.proof: Revision-specific compute passports distinguish measured, documented, derived, and predicted evidence; performance CI is public.

projects.name: Settler
projects.problem: Payment, banking, and operational records diverge unless matching and evidence rules are explicit.
projects.proof: Public reconciliation benchmark source and checked-in snapshots, with CI and security-invariant workflows.
